note: RIDEM camping area in a gravel lot on the east side of the Charlestown Breachway, between Ninigret Pond and Block Island Sound and a walk from the state beach. Fully self-contained units only (manufacturer-installed holding tanks; no tents, pop-ups, hybrids or canvas tops); one extra vehicle a site. Campers may use the dump and water fill at Burlingame or Fishermen's Memorial once at no charge. No open fires (propane stoves allowed) and no pets. Sites 58-75 back onto the breachway channel. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $18/$36, no utilities/dump/water, 75 back-in gravel RV-only sites 30-44 ft (max_rig 40 -> 44), self-contained rule; 2026 opened April 10 (opens 04-01 -> 04-10), no closing date posted.
